standard_prerequisites.name: The composition permanence of quasi-compactness
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 2854-2855)
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes retrocompact opens of the subspace retrocompact in the ambient space.

core_obligations: Transfer retrocompactness: retrocompact opens of the open subspace are retrocompact in the ambient space because the immersion is quasi-compact (proof lines 2851-2856)
Identify the constructible pieces: the traces of the ambient opens are differences of traces, which are constructible in the ambient space (proof lines 2857-2860)
Conclude: every constructible subset of the subspace is a finite union of such pieces, hence is the pullback of a constructible subset (proof lines 2860-2861)
proof_roadmap: 设 V, W ⊂ U 在 U 中 retrocompact 开 ⇒ 由复合保持准紧，它们在 X 中也 retrocompact 开。
V ∩ (U ∖ W) = V ∩ (X ∖ W) 在 X 中可构造。
U 的每个可构造子集是这类 V ∩ (U ∖ W) 的有限并 ⇒ 得证。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that constructible subsets of an open subspace pull back to constructible subsets of the ambient space when the immersion is quasi-compact (author lemma at source lines 2842-2849, label lemma-quasi-compact-open-immersion-constructible-inverse-image). The proof (source lines 2851-2861) transfers retrocompactness across the quasi-compact immersion, identifies the pieces with differences of ambient opens and concludes by taking finite unions (proof lines 2851-2861). The transfer of retrocompactness is the content. H3.
